headline: Aarhus were flat in Gent; the market still makes them clear favourites
summary: Aarhus lost their Conference League opener at Gent, creating just 0.23 expected goals, and their chance creation averages only 0.91 per game. Egnatia arrive with their first ever European point — 1-1 with Midtjylland — though Midtjylland out-created them and Egnatia finished on 0.59 expected goals. That is why, across 10 bookmakers with the margin removed, Aarhus are 64.7% to win, over 4 times Egnatia's 14.1%, and the handicap — the goals head start — rates Aarhus about a goal better than Egnatia.
read: Aarhus are clear favourites at home: the market has them 64.7% to win and more than a goal better on the handicap, and both numbers have moved further towards them in the last day. Egnatia arrive with their first ever European point and three wins in five, but Aarhus' flat 0-1 in Gent is the only European form on show.

facts.fact: Aarhus are 64.7% to win, more than four times Egnatia's 14.1%.
facts.meaning: A home win is rated clearly more likely than not; Egnatia are given roughly a one-in-seven chance.

facts.fact: Aarhus lost their Conference League opener 0-1 at Gent and managed just 0.23 xG to Gent's 2.24.
facts.meaning: They sit 29th of 36 with no points, so this home fixture is the one they are expected to take.

facts.fact: Aarhus' win chance rose from 61.4% to 64.7% in the last 24 hours.
facts.meaning: The home side has become a bigger favourite as kick-off approaches.

facts.fact: The fair handicap line moved from -0.99 to -1.14, with the main line now at -1.25.
facts.meaning: Aarhus are rated more than a goal better — a single-goal home win only half-covers -1.25.

facts.fact: Egnatia drew 1-1 with Midtjylland in their opening Conference League match, their first point in European competition.
facts.meaning: They arrive in Denmark on the back of the best European result in the club's history.

facts.fact: Egnatia have won three of their last five, most recently 3-1 at home to Vllaznia on Sunday.
facts.meaning: They arrive on a run of results, not on a one-off European night.

facts.fact: Aarhus have created only 0.91 xG per game over their last five matches.
facts.meaning: Their two wins in that run came without much sustained chance creation.

facts.fact: The goal line sits at 2.75, with the fair total moving from 2.64 to 2.78 in recent days.
facts.meaning: Just under three goals is the expected total, with Over 2.75 a fraction above a coin flip at 50.8%.

sources.fact: Egnatia coach Nevil Dede said ahead of the Aarhus match that the fixture congestion does not worry the team and that Egnatia are ready for the challenge.
Egnatia drew 1-1 with Midtjylland at Elbasan Arena, their first point in a European competition.
Egnatia beat Vllaznia in Rrogozhinë shortly after their first win over Dinamo, according to Shkodra Web.
Egnatia are described as the Albanian champions and will travel to face Aarhus at Cepheus Park for their second Conference League match.
After their first European point against Midtjylland, Egnatia will be looking to surprise another opponent in Aarhus, according to Newsport.
The match is the second round of the UEFA Conference League league phase, played at Aarhus's Ceres Park Vejlby.
